name: Uwasa no Midori-kun!! 2 Futari no Midori!?
original_name: うわさの翠くん!!2 ふたりの翠!?
source:
A popular manga has come to the NDS world! You take control of Midori. She is actually a girl, but she joins a boy's high school without telling her secret to anybody. One day, Midori and her friends carry out a training camp for a next soccer game. But, she meets Tsukasa, her first lover, there, and their checkered school life begins...

(from HimeyaShop)
